rules.pair: question 3 picks two mattresses: [first choice, alternative] (factory rules)
rules.order: score both with the weights of questions 1 and 2; the first one gets +2; if the alternative scores higher, swap them
rules.score: sum of weights for every tag the mattress has; 'support' is multiplied by the mattress support level (0-3)
rules.reason_line: sentence 1: the first choice's reason for question 3's tag (or its _default); sentence 2: its reason for the tag that scored most in questions 1-2, if any
rules.always: the result always shows a first choice and an alternative
